posts.title: Waxing Crescent (draft)
posts.description: May 26th, 1998 “This painting?” I asked. “Yes, the one in the window,” the realtor answered. “It must convey?” “Yes, the only condition of the sale is for that painting to convey. Also, no one can move or change it under any circumstances.
